hash_scope: Pins computed from exact authored UTF-8 source strings passed to apply_patch. ROOT must independently confirm saved file bytes; no filesystem reader or process was invoked.
observation_scope: In-memory source strings and display JSON schema only; no JS execution, full parser, DOM rendering, source project import, process sampling, calibration or scientific call.
ROOT_assembly_requirements: Bind original frozen five-context disposition: first raw semantic pass/full resource UNKNOWN; other4 unrun in that version. Do not rerun or retroactively globally qualify it.
Supply only actual owned actor records, explicit platform units/normalizations, parent/descendant/observer scopes and full receipt evidence. Empty arrays/null measurements are unavailable.
Memory table reproduces supplied observations without recomputing accounting, calibrating APIs, summing overlapping scopes or inferring gate acceptance.
Label scientific workers separately from non-scientific calibration workers. Leaf observers must be individually bound to declared ownership.

Milestone ROOT_qualified may be true only with bound actual calibration and/or new previously unexecuted donor progress, including complete actual terminal/resource dispositions. Design-only changes are insufficient.
Provide raw semantic and full resource dispositions independently for every phase/version; status pass is raw checks only.
Use complete owned phase clocks including declared immutable receipt-byte serialization, exit and reaping; report hard-link promotion/post-write observations/report/deployment costs outside phase.
Evidence links are local evidence/ paths without traversal, view.json or origins.json. Platform references may be supplied as exact local reference artifacts; no external URL auto-navigation.
ROOT reviews source syntax, view/raw correspondence and saved file hashes, adds a parent milestone only after actual progress, publishes and verifies live.
limitations: No actual data assembled and no live rendering/syntax-process check performed.
Role boxes are an explanatory key, not an asserted recorded process tree.
Source design establishes no platform result, accepted donor run, proof discovery, learner or benchmark superiority.
